I really like the block palette.

Something that you should consider doing is removing the diamond blocks. I think they will make the gameplay less balenced making it a lot more random and just a race for the diamonds. The person that gets them will make a set of armor and kill farm while not sharing any with teammates.

Other than that I think that the map will play decently. Looks like it would work well with the layout. Something that I would do is add some more cover but I think that it will be fine.
